title: Trees Tarantino Drops Atmospheric Hip-Hop Track "levelz•2it."
htmlContent:
Trees Tarantino, the multi-faceted music artist, has just released his latest single, "levelz•2it." The song is a sleek, sexy hip-hop crossover track with hard-hitting drums and an atmospheric, lush sound. Tarantino's influences across all genres and art forms are evident in the song, with his Memphis roots shining through.

Tarantino's passion for music and the arts has been a lifelong journey, with his father being a musician and providing him with access to instruments and thousands of CDs. In his youth, he taught himself to play drums and guitar, eventually becoming proficient in several instruments and booking shows for various bands.

After selling his guitars and drum set, Tarantino gravitated towards beat production and honed his skills in wordplay. He fell in love with hip-hop music and its limitless bounds for artistic self-expression, spending countless hours in the studio perfecting his craft and collaborating with fellow artists.

"levelz•2it" represents the culmination of Tarantino's journey, showcasing his dedication to the grind and relentless pursuit of perfection. The track is a must-listen for fans of atmospheric hip-hop and anyone looking for an immersive musical experience.
